# Custom Cursor

> A browser extension platform offering thousands of themed cursor packs featuring anime characters, Sanrio properties, gaming icons, and pop culture designs.

Custom Cursor allows users to personalize their browser experience with custom cursor collections across Chrome and Windows platforms. The site features curated selections of trending cursor packs, installation guides, and troubleshooting resources in multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Custom Cursor browser extension
- Anime character cursors
- Sanrio characters
- Cursor collections
- Chrome extension
- Cursor packs
- Browser customization
- Character cursors
- Popular franchises (One Piece, Among Us, Poppy Playtime)
- Kuromi and My Melody
- Windows 10 application
- Cursor management
- Fanart cursors
- Installation guides
- Trending cursor themes

## Browse Cursor Collections

- [Cursor Collections](https://custom-cursor.com/en/collections): Browse all themed cursor collections including anime, gaming, and movie cursor packs
- [Top Cursor Packs](https://custom-cursor.com/en/tops): Most popular and installed cursor packs ranked by user preferences
- [New Cursor Packs](https://custom-cursor.com/en/packs): Recently added cursor packs featuring anime, game, and pop culture character cursors
- [Editors Picks](https://custom-cursor.com/en/editors_picks): Curated editor selections of themed cursor pack compilations and seasonal picks

## Installation & Setup Guides

- [How to use Custom Cursor on Chrome](https://custom-cursor.com/en//how-to-use/chrome): Step-by-step guide to install and use Custom Cursor extension on Chrome
- [How to use Custom Cursor for Windows 10](https://custom-cursor.com/en/how-to-use/windows): Installation and setup guide for Custom Cursor Windows 10 desktop application

## Support & Troubleshooting

- [Custom Cursor Unblocked](https://custom-cursor.com/en/custom-cursor-unblocked): Troubleshooting guide for accessing Custom Cursor when blocked or unavailable
